description: This file defines Pydantic data models for schemas related to skills, roles, recommendations, graphs, assessments, and roadmaps in a career pathway navigator application.

classes.name: RecommendationOut
classes.description: Schema for recommendation output with fields like id, type, title, url, details, priority.

classes.name: SkillOut
classes.description: Schema for skill output with id, name, category, description.

classes.name: RoleSkillOut
classes.description: Schema linking skills to roles with required level, gap info, recommendations.

classes.name: RoleOut
classes.description: Basic role schema with id, name, description.

classes.name: RoleDetailOut
classes.description: Extended role schema including list of skills.

classes.name: ProgressOut
classes.description: Tracks progress for a role-skill pair with status and current level.

classes.name: GraphNode
classes.description: Graph node schema for D3 visualization, with id, type, label, optional entity info, color, gap, progress, percent complete.

classes.name: GraphLink
classes.description: Graph link schema with source, target, type, level, from, color, gap.

classes.name: GraphMeta
classes.description: Metadata for graph including roles and stats.

classes.name: GraphOut
classes.description: Complete graph schema with nodes, links, and meta.

classes.name: AssessmentIn
classes.description: Input schema for assessing current and target roles.

classes.name: AssessmentItem
classes.description: Represents skill assessment with skill name, current, required, and gap.

classes.name: AssessmentOut
classes.description: Output schema for assessment results including strengths, gaps, and meta.

classes.name: SkillRoleOut
classes.description: Reverse view of skill requirements per role.

classes.name: SkillDetailOut
classes.description: Detailed skill info including associated roles.

classes.name: RoadmapIn
classes.description: Input schema for creating or updating a roadmap.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configuration class for models to enable from_attributes mapping.
